body:
Add a `notes` field to lists: free-text, multiline, for information that's
useful but not needed regularly (e.g. "ask for the gate code", "store closes
6pm Sundays"). Lives ONLY in the list properties dialog/screen — not shown on
the list or overview screens, no special prominence.

Schema: `lists.notes TEXT`, `notes_ts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`,
`notes_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` — same field-level LWW pattern as
`name`/`category_order` (device_id-based `_by`, same as every other list
field; unrelated to the account-identity work in the item-authorship
ticket). Generous length cap (e.g. 5000 chars) to bound payload size;
validate server-side like other text fields.

Migration: this is a genuine schema change and there's no versioned
migration mechanism yet (T-57, open/unclaimed). Don't block on T-57 — a
single additive `ALTER TABLE lists ADD COLUMN notes ...` (+ ts/by columns)
with safe defaults is low-risk on SQLite; bundle a guarded one-off migration
in this ticket's server init path (see the equivalent note in the
item-authorship ticket, which needs the same treatment).

Wire contract: `notes` added to LIST_KEYS/LIST_TSBY alongside the other list
fields, flows through sync exactly like `name`.

Platform scope: Android full support (multiline OutlinedTextField in
ListPropsScreen, saved via the existing list-field-patch path used for
name/category_order). Web basic support is fine — a plain textarea in
ListPropsPage, save-on-dialog-close/submit is enough, no need for
autosave-on-keystroke polish.
title: List notes: free-text textarea in list properties
